title: The Change that Broke the Cannon's Back
description:
Minecraft is always changing, often for the better but sometimes for the worse. In this video we'll look at some of the chaotic changes throughout the 1.21 subversions that killed off many cannon designs, and build up a comprehensive understanding of how one tiny change could eliminate the anti-air arrow cannon.
